purpose: Structural subdivision universe for the 27 configured Tailmance markets. It prevents silent omission of state/province/region-level identifiers. Configured-scope source legal review is complete under the v20 official-source approval model; exact per-user subnational applicability remains runtime-context-bound and fail-closed when a material overlay is required. The ISO universe is not a claim that every municipality/free-zone/community creates a separate applicable legal regime.
